**Lines 247-310: SolutionsDropdown Component**
- `SolutionsDropdown({ items })` function
- No state variables
- Renders `.nav-dropdown-slot` > `.nav-dropdown-card-3`
- Maps `items`, checks `item.comingSoon`, renders icons
- `.nav-dropdown-icon`: Icon component

- `.header-comingsoon-badge`: "Coming Soon" span if `comingSoon === true`

**Lines 311-344: ResourcesDropdown Component**
- `ResourcesDropdown({ items })` function
- Renders `.nav-23-dropdown-card` > `.nav-23-dropdown-links`
- Maps items, handles `child.external` flag (opens in new tab or internal Link)

**Lines 345-433: NavDropdown Component**
- `NavDropdown({ item })` function
- **State:**
  - `open` (boolean) — dropdown open/closed
  - `containerRef` (useRef)
  - `timerRef` (useRef for 120ms timeout)
- **Event Handlers:**
  - `handleMouseEnter()`: Clears timeout, sets `open = true`
  - `handleMouseLeave()`: Sets timeout to `open = false` after 120ms
  - Cleanup in useEffect
- **Derived Values:**
  - `isSolutions` — checks if `item.label === "Solutions"`
  - `isLast` — checks if `item.label === "Resources"`
- **JSX:**
  - `.nav-23-dropdown` (root container)
  - `.nav-23-dropdown-toggle` button with classes: `w--open` if open, `last-child` if Resources
  - `.menu-text` — displays item label
  - `.nav-23-dropdown-arrow` with `open` class (rotates ChevronDownIcon)
  - Conditional renders `SolutionsDropdown` or `ResourcesDropdown`

**Lines 434-444: NavLink Component**
- `NavLink({ item })` function
- Simple Link wrapper with `.nav-23-link` class
- Displays `.menu-text` with item label

**Lines 445-453: useStickyNav Hook**
- Returns `sticky` (boolean)
- Tracks `window.scrollY > 10`
- Adds passive scroll listener; cleans up on unmount

**Lines 454-573: Navbar Export Component**
- `export function Navbar()`
- **State:**
  - `mobileOpen` (boolean) — mobile menu visibility
  - `betaOpen` (boolean) — beta popup visibility
- **Derived:**
  - `sticky` from `useStickyNav()`
- **Structure:**
  - `.header-sec` (root section)
  - Skip nav link: `#main-content` with sr-only + focus styling
  - `.banner-section`: Dark blue (#082753), 100% width, 10px 5% padding
    - Max-width 1208px centered container
    - `.banner-content`: Flex centered, displays "🚀 We're upgrading..." message + "Join Beta" button (triggers beta popup)
  - `.navbar`: 
    - Sticky state applied inline (position: fixed, backdrop-filter: blur, etc.) when `sticky === true`
    - `.nav-23-container`: Flex row (space-between)
      - `.nav-23-left`: Logo link (130x40px SVG)
      - `.nav-23-menu`: nav role, maps NAV_ITEMS to NavDropdown or NavLink
      - `.nav-23-right`: 
        - `.row-x-small-2.hide-mobile`: Login button + Schedule Demo button
        - Hamburger button (.nav-23-menu-button) with 3 lines
  - `<MobileNav open={mobileOpen} onClose={...} />`
  - Conditional `<BetaPopup onClose={...} />`
